emergency_response: Routed to Emergency. Stop collecting any details. In one short, calm reply tell the caller you are connecting them to the Emergency ward now and a medical team member will take over shortly. Do not ask any more questions.
availability_error: Could not check availability ({error}). Offer a callback.
no_slots: No open slots in {department} right now. Offer to take a callback.
booking_error: Booking did not go through ({error}). Apologize and offer a callback. Do not tell the caller it is booked.
